role: Independent read-only source/workflow reviewer; no nested agents, production/test edits, browser duplication or source mutation.
summary: The medium-complexity application and controlled experiment are verified on the reviewed final source: 37 native tests, four browser flows/126 checks, 30 diagnostic observations plus six regression outcomes. R1/R2/R3/R5 and the semantic Pagination defect are resolved. R4 remains a real historical workflow deviation; required metrics are unavailable. This completes a case study with explicit findings, not an all-gates-passed or causal-effectiveness claim.
publicationAssessment: A draft PR can accurately present the green application, evidence and unresolved workflow-quality limitations. This review does not certify the full nine-dimension quality bar or retroactively approve historical gates. Final repository report/traceability copying, commit and PR remain parent-owned.
